species.name: Crappie
why: Water 69°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 2–10 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 69°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 2–10 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
South wind at 9 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
